Edit the workbook (and save it in Excel so its values are cached), or WORD_RULES in the script, and re-run. Rune words: design/14 section 7 (Brent 2026-10-22). A skill is built on one base rune (skill_anchor); runes are added and linked. A saved word is rule-free (nodes + links, scripts/runes/rune_word.gd); 'rule_set' picks the rules in force from 'rule_sets' (each names a script extending RuneRules, plus its params). bond_v1 (scripts/runes/bond_rules.gd): single bonds; each rune makes at most its valence in bonds; a word is closed when every rune's bonds equal its valence. The electronegativity difference sets a bond's kind (bond_kinds, 'from' = smallest difference). Two base runes of different affinities bond only if the cosine of their affinity_positions is at least refuse_below; below weaken_below the bond is weakened. Universal runes have no position. Universal valence and electronegativity are PLACEHOLDERS (placeholder: true): Brent has not set them. Runes do not change any skill's numbers yet.
